MORE:
DRA Consultants Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 05/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1. To approve the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026, along with the Statement of Assets and Liabilities and Statement of Cash Flow for the half year ended on September 30, 2026.
2. To take on record the Limited Review Report on Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026.
